final: WITH g AS (SELECT t.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_band, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile) SELECT AVG(avg_band) AS avg_of_group_avgs, AVG(n) AS avg_of_group_counts FROM g
